Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon in one hand and a melee weapon in the other, or you are wielding a combination weapon.

You perform a coordinated assault that can throw yourself into a more advantageous position. You make two Strikes with this action, each with your current multiple attack penalty targeting the same target. One Strike must be a ranged Strike and the other must be a melee strike, done in an order of your choice. In-between these strikes, you can Step towards or away from the target. If the second Strike is made with a weapon that doesn’t have the agile trait, it takes a –2 penalty.

If you are using a combination weapon, as part of this action you can make either type of Strike with the same weapon without fully switching between forms. The weapon returns to its previous form after the second Strike.
